QUOTE: "When the second `llama_tokenize` returns a negative value (line 64), `LlamaCppTokenizer::tokenize` logs an error containing only the text length and returns `{}`, an empty vector." and "`do_count_tokens` ... Returns `0` | ... so the API cannot distinguish failure from empty text."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a failed tokenization yields an empty result, so the count path returns 0 with no error signal. It says this cannot be told apart from empty input.
